name: Ply
description: Three plies with the grain of each one at right angles to the last.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 9%, transparent 9% 18%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 9%, transparent 9% 18%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 22%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 9%, transparent 9% 18%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 9%, transparent 9% 18%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
